creative_direction.name: Plum Vesica Night Plaque
creative_direction.brief: 把双盘交叠读作一枚鱼形囊：深李子矿塑墙上印一枚硬边浅李色 vesica 竖瓣，瓣心精确对齐双盘交叠处，如把两圆相交的公共域放大成建筑壁龛；连续 honed 深李地面在真实基准线接墙，商品低立于地，接触阴影轻落塑面。下幅留出完整宽铭牌带：宽距 Arial 品牌字居带顶，Baskerville 题名以近满带宽的衬线大字居中统领，一条浅李细线横于带顶如龛缘刻度。矿塑的矿物哑光与晶带镜面互为冷暖与柔刚。参考 R1 的深色负空间与白铭牌对比层级与 R6 的中心光环隐喻。
creative_direction.material: deep plum mineral plaster wall with honed matching plum ground and one hard-edge pale vesica panel
creative_direction.lighting: soft diffuse nocturnal ambient with one broad calm glow on the vesica panel, gentle frontal matching the baked studio key, no hard shadows

background.prompt: Deep plum mineral plaster wall in matte aubergine tone meeting a continuous honed darker plum ground at a horizontal horizon seven tenths down the frame, one large hard-edge flat pale mauve vesica panel centred upper middle, matte mineral grain, soft diffuse nocturnal illumination, no objects
